decisive_spans.text: An induced sputum was trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert and subsequently grew MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid
Chest radiograph showed bilateral reticular-nodular opacities

response.rationale: The patient has positive MTB in sputum and bilateral reticular-nodular opacities on chest radiograph, which are direct evidence for pulmonary tuberculosis. While other forms of tuberculosis are present, the pulmonary involvement is clearly supported.
